concepts.name: Central Schema Authority (Liquibase disabled)
concepts.summary: Single source of truth for all platform database schemas. All backend services (TenantService, UserService, AgencyService, ConsultingTypeService) run with Liquibase DISABLED — schemas are version-controlled and applied from here, never auto-migrated at service startup.

concepts.name: MariaDB Schemas (7 databases)
concepts.summary: Per-service schema.sql files for agencyservice, consultingtypeservice, tenantservice, userservice, videoservice, uploadservice, and the shared caritas database.

concepts.name: Polyglot Stores (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis)
concepts.summary: Beyond MariaDB: MongoDB dumps for consulting types/application settings, PostgreSQL for Matrix/Synapse (status doc), plus RabbitMQ and Redis notes — each with its own README.

concepts.name: Incident 2026-02 Remediation & Secret Management
concepts.summary: docs/incident-2026-02/db-c03-remediation.md documents the remediation of the February 2026 MariaDB exposure incident; docs/secret-management.md defines how database credentials are stored and rotated.

concepts.name: In-Cluster MariaDB Client
concepts.summary: k8s/mariadb-client provides a kustomize-deployed database client (deployment, service, ingress, configmap) for admin access to MariaDB inside the cluster.

flows.name: New Environment Initialization
flows.summary: scripts/database-initialize.yaml provisions the databases → per-service schema.sql files create the tables → scripts/system-users-job.yaml creates the system users; MongoDB collections restored from the tracked dumps.

flows.name: SQL Escaping Test
flows.summary: tests/test-sql-escaping.sh validates schema files for escaping errors before they are applied to a live database.
